source.name: Footy Headlines: Belgium 2026 World Cup Home Kit Released
source.quote: Adidas officially unveils Belgium’s 2026 home kit, featuring a “flames of the Red Devils” design that symbolizes the team’s courageous and bold spirit
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers (same as germany-2026-home). The launch article's gallery covers every mark on the shirt: studio front, back, full-kit (shorts and socks) and replica photos show only the adidas performance logo and the RBFA crest; the collar and sleeve-cuff trim are tricolor only. No commercial sponsor on any placement.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: adidas's red 2026 home shirt for Belgium (worn by the Red Devils and Red Flames in the 2026-2027 international cycle) carries only the adidas logo, the RBFA crest and a tulip-and-flames pattern; the launch photos show clean sleeves and plain black adidas-striped shorts (Footy Headlines' launch description and images).
